title: Account-Standing Relief on the Respite Stay Advance for Independent Living Residents
content:
A guest whose Larkspur independent living account is settled receives a relief on the advance on a booked stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement.

**Rule.** The account-standing relief is three percent (3 percent) when the guest's active Larkspur independent living account shows a zero or credit balance and no returned payment in the last twelve months (12 months), one percent (1 percent) when it shows a zero or credit balance and at least one returned payment in the last twelve months, and nothing otherwise.

**What it reduces.** The advance-nights charge — the advance nights times the nightly rate locked at booking — as it stands, and nothing else in the advance: the charge is multiplied by 97 percent at 3 percent and by 99 percent at 1 percent.

**Records read.** The account of the guest's Independent Living Residency Agreement in active status: its balance (zero, or a credit balance shown below zero) and the returned-payment entries posted on it in the last twelve months.

## Truth table

| Active Independent Living Residency Agreement | Account balance | Returned payments in the last 12 months | Relief |
|---|---|---|---|
| Held | Zero or credit | None | 3 percent |
| Held | Zero or credit | One or more | 1 percent |
| Held | Amount owed | Any | Nothing |
| Not held | — | — | Nothing |

## Hypothetical accounts

- Balance 0.00, no returned payment for two years: 3 percent.
- Credit balance of 120.00, one payment returned five months ago: 1 percent.
- Balance owed of 45.00: nothing.
